notes: «قال عمرو فحدثت به بكير بن الأشج فقال حدثني كريب بذلك» comes after the saying and names Bukayr as a different transmitter of it: a variant group, not a route; Amr's own telling to Bukayr is left out
«كريب، مولى ابن عباس» is one link: the patron stays in the name; the second «ابن عباس» is the Companion (occurrence 2)
